wish_1_rule.value: This is the first hint: a gentle nudge to help the child understand what the question is asking or what to notice first.
wish_1_rule.description: How strong the first hint should be.

wish_2_rule.value: This is the second hint: a more specific nudge towards the method or the next step, still without the answer.
wish_2_rule.description: How strong the second hint should be.

max_chars.description: Hints longer than this are rejected (the app then shows its own written hint).
